title: Hien’s BLE robot
author: Nguyen Van Hien
status: Video analysis and proposed power/servo distribution; not original CAD release

parts.name: Launch motors
parts.note: Twin 3-phase outrunners direct-drive the launch wheels; high torque and speed.

parts.name: Speed controllers
parts.note: 18 A continuous brushless ESCs; powered from ATX 12 V high-current rail.

parts.name: Launch wheels
parts.note: 40A middle-soft shore durometer elastomer tire grips the 40 mm ball.

parts.name: Wheel mounts
parts.spec: BaneBots 1/2" hex hub with 4 mm bore
parts.note: Couples the DT750 4 mm motor shaft to the BaneBots 1/2" hex wheel bore.

parts.name: Launch barrel & mounts
parts.spec: 3D-printed barrel and motor tabs (canon v54, motor_mount_tab_ext v58)
parts.note: Autodesk Fusion 360 assembly ASM v145; holds twin motors with wheel cutouts.

parts.name: Hopper container
parts.note: Bulk ball container mounted above the rotary agitation and feed throat.

parts.name: Feeder agitator servo
parts.note: Rotates the bottom agitator disk (pusher_with_servo v12) to prevent bridging.

parts.name: Feeder gate servo
parts.note: Actuates the escapement gate (feed_base_with_servo v52) to meter balls.

parts.name: Feed throat
parts.note: Curves balls down by gravity from the hopper bottom into the launch barrel.

parts.name: Turntable bearing
parts.spec: 120 mm Aluminum Lazy Susan rotating plate (Amazon B07F3VHGKX)
parts.note: Circular ball-bearing ring supports robot weight and enables 360° pan rotation.

parts.name: Pan / yaw servo
parts.note: Mounted to vertical base bracket (base_leg v15); sweeps launcher horizontally.

parts.name: Tilt / elevation servo
parts.note: Acts on circular quadrant horn (hand_servo v64) to control pitch angle.

parts.name: Controller
parts.note: Generates 6 independent servo/ESC PWM signals and handles BLE hardware serial.

parts.name: Bluetooth module
parts.note: Enables wireless command link from custom iOS iPhone app (Ping Robot).

parts.name: Power supply
parts.note: Provides heavy 12 V rail for brushless ESCs and 5 V rail for the 4 servos.

parts.name: Base enclosure
parts.note: Houses ATX PSU, Arduino Mega, ESCs, wiring harness, and turntable mount.

parts.name: Power switch
parts.note: Top deck switch pulls ATX PS_ON green wire to ground to turn on DC rails.

parts.name: Power & servo breakout
parts.note: J1–J9, ATX Molex input, C1 1000 µF, C2 470 µF, C3 100 nF; unrouted draft.

parts.name: BLE level divider
parts.spec: 1 kΩ and 2 kΩ 1/4W metal film resistors
parts.note: Protects HM-10 3.3 V RX input from Arduino Mega 5 V TX1 output signal.

parts.name: Rail filter capacitors
parts.note: Smooths 12 V brushless ESC switching noise and 5 V servo stall surges.

parts.name: Wiring harness & terminals
parts.spec: 10-pin Mega harness, Molex connector, 3-pin headers, 3.5 mm bullets
parts.note: Organized clean wiring between wooden base electronics and moving gimbal.

connections.note: Common ground reference across Mega, ESCs, servos, and ATX supply.
Feeds logic rail and HM-10 BLE module; isolated from high-current servo 5 V.
Hardware PWM signal for top DT750 ESC (throttle / topspin bias).
Hardware PWM signal for bottom DT750 ESC (throttle / backspin bias).
PWM control signal for hopper rotary agitator disk servo.
PWM control signal for feed escapement gate servo.
PWM control signal for horizontal turntable yaw servo.
PWM control signal for vertical pitch elevation quadrant servo.
Serial data to HM-10 RX via onboard 1 kΩ / 2 kΩ resistor voltage divider.
Serial data directly from HM-10 TX (3.3 V high satisfies Mega Vih threshold).
3-pin headers for ESC signal lines (GND and signal; ESC BEC wire disconnected).
3-pin headers with high-current ATX +5V, GND, and independent signal line.
Yellow (+12 V to ESCs), Red (+5 V to servos), Black (GND), Green (PS_ON).

modes.name: Service
modes.behavior: Ball bounces on the launcher’s near table half before clearing the net into opponent’s court.

modes.name: Attack
modes.aim: Flat to slight upward pitch (0° to +8°)
modes.behavior: High velocity offensive drive flying straight over the net to target corners.

modes.name: Topspin vs Backspin
modes.behavior: Top wheel faster produces diving topspin; bottom wheel faster produces floating backspin.

modes.name: Swing / Random
modes.behavior: Turntable servo oscillates or randomly targets forehand and backhand zones.
